calls.title: Susanne Keenan and Ashley Stirrup
calls.summary: Growth Book is experiencing rapid growth, doubling its revenue to $8 million, primarily from enterprise customers who contribute 75% of revenue. The company has expanded its sales team from one to six representatives and identified necessary process improvements, especially in billing and renewals. It is positioned as a leading engineering-friendly experimentation platform focusing on warehouse integration and privacy-conscious self-hosted options. Marketing efforts are ramping up with a new team emphasizing SEO and content strategies. A new marketing hire with a strong alignment to developer and cybersecurity markets is being sought to enhance strategic execution and manage daily demands effectively.
calls.keywords: Growth Book, AB testing, self-hosted experimentation, AI integration, Marketing ops, SEO strategy
calls.action_items:
**Ashley Stirrup**
Schedule a follow-up meeting with Susanne Keenan for a deeper discussion on candidate fit and strategic marketing topics (28:10)
Continue building marketing operations infrastructure including lead routing, lead scoring, and cleaning contract and renewal tracking processes with support from the hired fractional CFO and revenue operations team (09:40)
Develop strategy and hire team members for demand generation and developer relations roles to enhance marketing efforts (03:30)

**Susanne Keenan**
Prepare for detailed follow-up interview focusing on hands-on and strategic marketing experience as well as enterprise content expertise (28:20)
